title: BioAgent
tagline: Infrastructure for connectome-driven agents that turn onchain signals into adaptive actions
description: bioAgent is infrastructure for adaptive agents powered by biological connectomes. It connects onchain signals to neural computation, actions, and learning, with a shared profile for model provenance and state. Our demos use the MaleCNS fly connectome for a foraging playground and a market where four agents provide liquidity through 1inch Aqua or trade against Aqua and Uniswap.
how_its_made: We combine Foundry-tested Solidity contracts, a Python sparse neural runtime, and a JavaScript UI. Each local agent runs 166,700 MaleCNS neurons with independent state. Confirmed onchain inputs drive decisions, and outcomes update a lightweight action readout. The market uses official Aqua contracts on a local Ethereum fork and Uniswap V3 with shared test tokens. Receipts and balance checks verify actual transfers.
